gaps.explanation: The only transfers-in line in detail is the budget schedule's all-funds 'Transfers' 45,914 (detail index 11; Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - Total Primary Government, trimmed p20 = printed p48, unaudited), covering governmental and business-type funds together and tagged governmental. The fund statements print transfers per fund column: governmental funds statement trimmed p10 (printed p23) Transfers In General Fund 6,001, Street and Alley Fund 30,000 (City Hall, Park 0; Pool, Grants 0 on trimmed p11); proprietary statement trimmed p17 (printed p30) Electric (6,113), Sewer 3,800, Water 3,713, Trash (1,200) (added under business-type transfers_net). Per the per-fund rule the combined line is replaced by the fund-column lines: remove index 11 (45,914), add General 6,001 + Street and Alley 30,000 = 36,001. Governmental transfers in become 36,001 vs statement Total 4,800: the remaining 31,201 is exactly the printed Adjustments column (31,201) on trimmed p11 that nets the governmental interfund transfers (same amount as on the transfers_out side, first pass), i.e. gross per fund vs netted Total only (different basis by rule). The budget's 45,914 is 2,400 more than the printed fund-column transfers in (36,001 + 7,513 = 43,514); the budget is cash basis and unaudited, so the statement figures are used.
